source: Klikk-YearEnd-Audit-Procedures.md v1 (19 Aug 2026) — section 2, the check registry (v1)
note: Static fallback list of the 45 planned checks. Shown only while audit.checks has not been built yet. Severity and SQL text come from the live registry once it exists.

checks.title: Xero journal mirror fresh
checks.description: Catches a stale xero_data_xerojournals mirror.
checks.rationale: Everything downstream is unreliable if the mirror is behind.
checks.sql_text: max(date) per tenant >= today - 2

checks.title: Investec mirror fresh, all accounts
checks.description: Catches a stale bank mirror on any account.
checks.rationale: Bank-to-books checks silently pass when the bank side is empty.
checks.sql_text: max(transaction_date) per account >= today - 3

checks.title: Trial balance nets to zero per FY
checks.description: Catches dropped VAT legs and half-ingested journals (the Aug 2026 bug).
checks.rationale: A non-zero TB means the mirror lost legs; every allocation check inherits the error.
checks.sql_text: sum(debit) - sum(credit) grouped by FY

checks.title: Voided journals in mirror
checks.description: Catches double-ingested voided journals (the Boschendal x2 bug).
checks.rationale: Voided journals ingested alongside their live twin double-count spend.
checks.sql_text: exact-duplicate journal sets

checks.title: Aged payables/receivables tables populated
checks.description: Catches an empty xero_data_agedpayable (found 18 Aug 2026).
checks.rationale: Empty ageing tables make BAL-06/BAL-07 pass vacuously.
checks.sql_text: count(*) > 0

checks.title: Attachment coverage known
checks.description: Catches rows where has_attachments is null.
checks.rationale: Unknown attachment state hides missing source documents.
checks.sql_text: count(*) where has_attachments is null

checks.title: Xero connection healthy, no tenant reauth_required
checks.description: Catches a dead or expired Xero token.
checks.rationale: A dead token silently freezes the mirror.
checks.sql_text: connection status endpoint

checks.title: Slips with no Xero match (non-meals)
checks.description: Catches uncaptured purchases evidenced by a slip.
checks.rationale: The Slippies register is the receipts source-of-record; anything there without a book entry is uncaptured spend.
checks.sql_text: whatsapp.klikk_slips left join Xero lines on amount/date window

checks.title: Slips with no Xero match (meals)
checks.description: Separates the meals policy pile from genuine capture gaps.
checks.rationale: Meals are a policy decision, not a bookkeeping error — they need MC, not the bookkeeper.
checks.sql_text: as DOC-01, restricted to meal suppliers

checks.title: Klikk expense lines with no slip AND no Xero attachment
checks.description: Catches voucher-less spend of R1,000 or more.
checks.rationale: Spend without any supporting document cannot be defended at audit or to SARS.
checks.sql_text: expense lines >= 1000 with no slip match and has_attachments = false

checks.title: Invoice emails in mc@ never forwarded to accounts@
checks.description: Catches intake bypass — invoices that never reached the bookkeeper alias.
checks.rationale: Two intake channels exist; anything that lands only in mc@ is invisible to the books.
checks.sql_text: mailbox sweep, per supplier

checks.title: Xero bills without attachment, by supplier
checks.description: Catches missing source documents, grouped by supplier.
checks.rationale: Coverage per supplier shows which relationships need a document discipline fix.
checks.sql_text: attachment coverage % per supplier

checks.title: Slip group messages with no file in register
checks.description: Catches lost media — a message in the Slippies group whose file never synced.
checks.rationale: A missing file means the register understates evidence and DOC-01 under-reports.
checks.sql_text: whatsapp messages with media flag but no klikk_slips row

checks.title: Klikk-account debits with no Xero journal (±5d, same amount)
checks.description: Catches unbooked business payments.
checks.rationale: Money left the business account and never reached the ledger.
checks.sql_text: bank debits left join journals on amount within 5 days

checks.title: Personal-account debits to known Klikk suppliers with no Klikk journal
checks.description: Catches the DME R90k / Aurras R64k / Expedition R24k pattern — business spend paid personally and never booked.
checks.rationale: R393k of personal payments to business suppliers was missing from the books in the Aug 2026 allocation audit.
checks.sql_text: personal bank debits to supplier name set, minus matched Klikk journals

checks.title: Klikk-account credits from suppliers (refunds) not in Xero
checks.description: Catches unbooked supplier refunds.
checks.rationale: Refunds received but not booked overstate expenses.
checks.sql_text: bank credits from supplier set with no matching credit note

checks.title: Journals with no bank movement (non-accrual accounts)
checks.description: Catches phantom payments — a payment journal with no money actually moving.
checks.rationale: The mirror image of BNK-01; both directions must be tested.
checks.sql_text: payment journals left join bank on amount/date window

checks.title: Payment referencing a bill number that has no bill
checks.description: Catches 'Payment made - Bill X' where bill X does not exist.
checks.rationale: The payment cannot be reconciled to an invoice that was never created.
checks.sql_text: payment narrations parsed for bill refs, anti-joined to bills

checks.title: Payment dated before its bill
checks.description: Catches the DME 0605 pattern.
checks.rationale: A payment preceding its invoice usually means the bill was back-created to fit the payment.
checks.sql_text: payments joined to bills where payment_date < bill_date

checks.title: Bill with 2+ payments
checks.description: Catches double payment of the same bill.
checks.rationale: Duplicated settlement is cash out the door that can be recovered.
checks.sql_text: bills having count(payments) > 1

checks.title: Same supplier, same amount, within 7 days, different journals
checks.description: Catches duplicate capture of one transaction.
checks.rationale: Must be verified live-vs-voided before being reported (see RDY-04).
checks.sql_text: self-join on supplier + amount within 7 days

checks.title: Payment allocated directly from bank with NO bill behind it
checks.description: Catches bank spend coded straight to an expense account, with no bill created — so the supplier invoice can never be allocated later (MoneyBadgers 10 Dec / 4 Jan).
checks.rationale: Raised by MC on 19 Aug 2026. Without a bill, the invoice has nothing to attach to and the supplier account never reconciles.
checks.sql_text: bank-sourced expense lines with no linked bill, per supplier

checks.title: Supplier invoice number reused / paid twice
checks.description: Catches the INV-035 reuse and CW Plumbers #19 pattern.
checks.rationale: A reused invoice number is either a supplier error or a double claim.
checks.sql_text: bills grouped by supplier + invoice number having count > 1

checks.title: Supplier statement three-way tie (when statement held)
checks.description: Catches bank paid != statement received != Xero.
checks.rationale: The three-way tie is the only way to prove a supplier account is clean.
checks.sql_text: statement lines vs bank vs Xero, per supplier

checks.title: Supplier name fragmentation
checks.description: Catches 'Carry on' vs 'Carry On', four separate BP contacts, etc.
checks.rationale: Fragmented contacts break every per-supplier check above.
checks.sql_text: fuzzy match over contact names

checks.title: Deposits held by suppliers where supplier activity ended
checks.description: Asset sitting in a 'Deposit on ...' account, last payment more than 90 days ago, and no refund credit received.
checks.rationale: The MoneyBadgers lesson — R9,813.33 correctly booked Sep 2025, lease ended Jan 2026, never recovered. Three audits missed it because they all tested transactions, not balances over time.
checks.sql_text: deposit accounts joined to last supplier activity, minus refund credits

checks.title: Supplier prepayments / credits not consumed within 90 days
checks.description: Catches overpayments sitting unused on supplier accounts.
checks.rationale: Same lifecycle principle as BAL-01 — correct when booked, wrong by staying.
checks.sql_text: prepayments/credits with age > 90 days and no offset

checks.title: Tenant deposits held vs active leases
checks.description: Catches deposits for departed tenants never refunded or forfeited.
checks.rationale: A deposit liability outliving its lease is either money owed back or income not recognised.
checks.sql_text: deposit liability accounts joined to lease end dates

checks.title: Director/shareholder loan movements without corresponding expense
checks.description: Catches the loan-without-expense pattern (R320k ambiguous in the Aug 2026 audit).
checks.rationale: Loan-account movements with no expense behind them are unexplained value transfers.
checks.sql_text: loan account movements anti-joined to expense journals

checks.title: Accrued / retention balances older than 12 months
checks.description: Catches stale accruals and retentions.
checks.rationale: Accruals that never reverse distort both the balance sheet and the P&L.
checks.sql_text: accrual/retention account balances with age > 12 months

checks.title: Aged payables > 90 days
checks.description: Catches unpaid or mis-allocated payables.
checks.rationale: Old payables are usually either a real debt or a capture error.
checks.sql_text: xero_data_agedpayable where age_bucket > 90

checks.title: Aged receivables > 90 days
checks.description: Catches uncollected receivables.
checks.rationale: Old receivables are either collectable cash or an overdue write-off decision.
checks.sql_text: xero_data_agedreceivable where age_bucket > 90

checks.title: Supplier allocated outside its dominant account (70% rule)
checks.description: Catches misallocation against a supplier's own history.
checks.rationale: A supplier with 70%+ of spend in one account is a strong prior; outliers are usually errors.
checks.sql_text: per-supplier account distribution, flag lines outside the dominant account

checks.title: Description contradicts account
checks.description: Catches e.g. fuel coded to Sound Equipment, via keyword heuristics.
checks.rationale: The narration usually tells the truth when the account code does not.
checks.sql_text: keyword-to-account heuristic table over line descriptions

checks.title: Repair-vs-improvement consistency per contractor
checks.description: Catches DME R77k expensed against R745k capitalised.
checks.rationale: Inconsistent treatment for one contractor on similar work is a SARS exposure.
checks.sql_text: per-contractor split of expensed vs capitalised amounts

checks.title: Asset threshold breaches
checks.description: Items of R7,000 or more sitting in '<7000' accounts, and items under R1,000 capitalised.
checks.rationale: The capitalisation threshold must be applied consistently for wear-and-tear claims.
checks.sql_text: amount vs account threshold, both directions

checks.title: Input VAT claimed on entertainment
checks.description: Catches s17(2) denied input VAT.
checks.rationale: Entertainment input VAT is denied by the VAT Act; claiming it is a straight assessment risk.
checks.sql_text: entertainment accounts with non-zero input VAT

checks.title: Vatable supplier, VAT-inclusive capture, no VAT split
checks.description: Catches unclaimed input VAT.
checks.rationale: The mirror of ALC-05 — money left on the table rather than a risk.
checks.sql_text: VAT-registered suppliers with lines captured at zero VAT

checks.title: Income credited into expense accounts
checks.description: Catches e.g. R40k/month rental income sitting in Rental Expense.
checks.rationale: Understates both income and expenses; distorts every margin.
checks.sql_text: credit balances in expense accounts

checks.title: Future-dated journals
checks.description: Catches the 2029-09-22 pair and anything like it.
checks.rationale: Future-dated journals fall outside every FY report and go unnoticed.
checks.sql_text: journals where date > today

checks.title: Loan-vs-expense routing inconsistency per supplier
checks.description: Catches the same supplier (e.g. restaurants) routed both ways in one month.
checks.rationale: Inconsistent routing means there is no policy — one must be set.
checks.sql_text: per-supplier per-month split of loan-account vs expense-account routing

checks.title: Round-amount manual journals >= R5k between bond / shareholder loans
checks.description: Surfaces potential s64E deemed-dividend exposure.
checks.rationale: Round-amount transfers between loan accounts are the classic deemed-dividend fact pattern.
checks.sql_text: manual journals between loan accounts, amount >= 5000 and amount % 1000 = 0

checks.title: Recurring suppliers with < 50% of invoices reaching accounts@
checks.description: Identifies suppliers that need an auto-forward rule.
checks.rationale: Fixes the cause of DOC-04 rather than re-finding it every year.
checks.sql_text: per-supplier invoice count in mailbox vs count reaching accounts@

checks.title: Suppliers with 'bank details changed' text in a recent invoice
checks.description: Fraud flag (WeCare, Aug 2026).
checks.rationale: Changed banking details on an invoice is the single highest-yield payment-fraud signal.
checks.sql_text: full-text search over recent invoice documents

checks.title: Supplier invoices in mailbox with no Xero bill and no payment
checks.description: Catches unpaid and unbooked invoices (e.g. MoneyBadgers INV-0055).
checks.rationale: An invoice that never became a bill is a liability nobody is tracking.
checks.sql_text: mailbox invoices anti-joined to bills and payments
